titles.th: เฟต/อโพคริฟา
titles.vi: Cuộc chiến Chén Thánh: Ngụy thư

1.overview: The freelance necromancer Kairi Sisigou is called to the Mage’s Association in London for a special request. There, he is asked to participate in the Great Holy Grail War to recover the stolen Greater Grail system of Fuyuki. In this great war, seven masters and servants of the Red faction will battle against seven masters and servants of the Black faction in the city of Trifas, Romania.
1.summary:
Decades have passed since the Greater Grail was taken from Fuyuki. The Mage’s Association asks Kairi Sisigou to take part in the Great Holy Grail War.
Source: Netflix

2.overview: A girl lost in thought on a bus ride in the night – Ruler. Unusually summoned through the union of her spirit and a French girl, she feels something is amiss in the war to come. To fulfill her role as Ruler over this war, she departs for Trifas.
2.summary:
Despite harboring doubts about her unusual summoning, Ruler heads to the battleground in Trifas, Romania, to preside over the Great Holy Grail War.
Source: Netflix

3.overview: A homunculus boy awakens in his incubation tank. Assaulted with visions of the fate of his comrades, he manages to escape confinement. Unfortunately, he lacks the strength to make it to the outside world and is instead found collapsed on the ground by Rider of Black.
3.summary:
A young homunculus boy tries to escape after waking up inside a tank. Just as his strength gives out, Rider of Black appears.
Source: Netflix

title.ja: 生の代償, 死の償い
title.en: Price of Life, Redemption of Death
title.de: Der Preis ist das Leben, der Tod die Erlösung
title.x-jat: Sei no Daishou, Shi no Tsugunai

4.overview: A rampaging Berserker of Red is rapidly approaching the Yggdmillennia citadel, prompting them to respond. Meanwhile, the homunculus boy ponders the meaning of his existence and the conversation he had with Archer of Black.
4.summary:
Berserker of Red approaches the Black Faction stronghold. The Yggdmillennia clan and their Servants seize the opportunity to take action.
Source: Netflix

5.overview: Saber of Black devotes his heart to the boy who desired freedom. In his last moments, Ruler promises that she will grant the boy that freedom and ensure that Saber’s wish will come true.
5.summary:
Saber of Black vanishes after giving his heart to the young homunculus boy. Ruler swears to do everything in her power to grant him his freedom.
Source: Netflix

6.overview: Kairi Sisigou receives a message from the Mage’s Association that a string of violent murders is taking place in Sighișoara and is probably related to the yet unaccounted for Assassin of Black. He is tasked with bringing the out of control master and servant to justice for failing to follow the principle of mystical concealment.
6.summary:
Believing a Servant could be behind the string of gruesome murders terrorizing Romania, the Mage`s Association sends in Kairi to investigate.
Source: Netflix

7.overview: Fiore Yggdmillenia, who was also visiting Sighișoara to contact the master of Assassin of Black, unfortunately runs into Kairi Sisigou and is engaged in battle.
7.summary:
Fiore battles Sisigou after traveling to Sighișoara in pursuit of Assassin of Black. In the face of danger, a familiar figure rushes to her side.
Source: Netflix

8.overview: Assassin of Red’s Noble Phantasm, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, is activated as the Red faction prepares its all-out assault on the Black faction’s citadel. The Great Holy Grail War enters a new violent phase while Ruler and Sieg make their way to the battlefield.
8.summary:
The Great Holy Grail War enters a new phase as the Black and Red factions engage in an all-out conflict. Ruler and Sieg both head to the battlefield.
Source: Netflix

title.en: One Hundred Flames and One Hundred Flowers
title.x-jat: Hyaku no Honoo to Hyaku no Hana

9.overview: Berserker of Black suddenly comes across the master of Assassin of Red, Shirou Kotomine. Berserker of Red returns to the battlefield under the control of Caster of Black, causing more confusion among the participants of the Great Holy Grail War. Archer of Black and Rider of Red engage in a battle of teacher against pupil.
9.summary:
With the battles raging on, the Rider of Red learns who the Archer of Black is, forcing him to take on his former master.
Source: Netflix

10.overview: Sieg comes to the rescue of Rider of Black and confronts Saber of Red. Berserker of Black also arrives and attacks, while her master Caules Yggdmillenia struggles with the choices he has in the form of the Command Spells.
10.summary:
Sieg stands up to fight a formidable foe and protect his savior, the Rider of Black. Though weak, he`s soon joined by a hell-bent Berserker of Black.
Source: Netflix

11.overview: Saber of Black responds to Sieg's willingness to fight, the battle between Lancer of Red and Lancer of Black heats up considerably, and Darnic comes to a decision regarding his plan.
11.summary:
The battle between the Lancers of Red and Black heats up, yet they remain gridlocked. Watching, Darnic hatches a plan to get what he wants.
Source: Netflix

12.overview: Assassin of Red's Hanging Gardens of Babylon arrive over the Yggdmillennia Citadel and excavate the Greater Grail that was buried underground. The Black faction boards the flying fortress to fight off the invading Red faction, but Lancer of Black's territorial advantage wanes...
12.summary:
Ruler and the Black Faction rush into the Sky Garden in chase of the Red Faction, who are now in possession of the Greater Grail.
Source: Netflix

13.overview: In the Hanging Gardens, Shirou lays bare his wish for the Holy Grail, while on the ground Rider of Black is forced to act against his own by his master Celenike Yggdmillennia.
13.summary:
Sieg admits that he can`t give up his desire to help his brethren, and the Rider of Black gives him his full support. Until Celenike shows up.
Source: Netflix

14.overview:
Sieg works with the other homunculus to patch up the wounded when a very angry Ruler appears.
Meanwhile, the remaining Yggdmillennia masters discuss what to do following Caster of Black's betrayal.
14.summary:
Despite Roche`s blind admiration for Avicebron, the Caster of Black reveals to Roche his deep-seated reasons for turning on the Black Faction.
Source: Netflix

title.de: Auch wenn unsere Wege sich trennen

15.overview: New allies and old enemies reform their ranks as the change of ownership of the Greater Grail leaves various parties reminiscing on their past and the road taken.
15.summary:
To stop Shiro, acting head of the Yggdmillennia clan Fiore proposes a joint attack on the Hanging Garden with Sisigou and others.
Source: Netflix

title.ja: ジャック・ザ・リッパー

16.overview: Assassin of Black moves closer to Trifas on their killing spree, forcing the remaining members of the Yggdmillenia clan to act against them.
16.summary:
When the mysterious Jack the Ripper resurfaces to slaughter more magi, Fiore forms a plan to corner the killer.
Source: Netflix

17.overview: Ruler takes Sieg out on a date in Trifas under the guise of luring out Assassin of Black but ends up enjoying this reverie more than she expected.
17.summary:
While walking through town in hopes of luring out Jack the Ripper, Sieg and Jeanne observe the townspeople and discuss what it means to be human.
Source: Netflix

18.overview: With her Command Spells, the master of Assassin of Black unleashes a vision of Hell within the mist. To those caught in it, the tormenting trap is all but inescapable.
18.summary:
Pulled into Jack the Ripper`s nightmare filled with lost and abandoned children, Jeanne makes a fateful decision to lay the lost souls to rest.
Source: Netflix

19.overview: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon are quickly leaving Romania, forcing the remaining Yggdmillennia masters, Ruler and Kairi Sisigou to formulate the best plan of action to intercept the flying fortress.
19.summary:
The Hanging Garden is moving out of range, with the chance for a final battle swiftly approaching. Caules pushes Fiore to make a choice.
Source: Netflix

20.overview: The masters and servants of the reformed Black Faction renew their convictions as they head out for what they plan to be the last battle of the Great Holy Grail War.
20.summary:
The Yggdmillennia alliance make their final preparations before setting out for the Hanging Garden. Jeanne reminds Sieg of the power that lies within him.
Source: Netflix

title.ja: 天蠍一射[アンタレス・スナイプ]

21.overview: The Great Holy Grail War resumes in midair on the Black faction's approach of the Hanging Gardens, with the servants of Red choosing their opponents to fulfill promises or curses made on the battlefield.
21.summary:
Chiron battles his former disciple, Achilles, in a bare-knuckle fight. As Astolfo and Sieg attack the Hanging Garden, Sieg makes a fateful decision.
Source: Netflix

22.overview: The battle between fated adversaries intensifies, with Ruler facing off against Archer of Red and Saber of Black appearing in front of Lancer of Red.
22.summary:
Mad with fury and unable to forgive Ruler for what she did to the Jack the Ripper children, Atalanta challenges her to a battle to the death.
Source: Netflix

23.overview: Saber of Red confronts Assassin of Red and Ruler struggles with Caster of Red's machinations.
23.summary:
A merciless attack by Semiramis leaves Kairi and Mordred heavily wounded. Shakespeare leads Jeanne down a painful journey into her past.
Source: Netflix

24.overview: Shirou reaches the Great Holy Grail and states his wish while Ruler, supported by friends old and new, activates her Noble Phantasm.
24.summary:
Shiro declares that he`s attained Third Magic and is now able to "save the world," but Jeanne firmly believes that he`s wrong in his beliefs.
Source: Netflix

25.overview: A boy once stood opposed to Shirou's wish, wielding a sword to fulfill his own. Thus the wishes intertwined into "Apocrypha."
25.summary:
Shiro and Semiramis make peace with themselves as their world crumbles around them. Young Sieg makes a shattering choice in an attempt to change fate.
Source: Netflix
